provenance.note: A dark FM bell: the bell's inharmonic ratio (3.51) under a lid at 1.7 kHz, its clang in the first third of a second and a ring of four and a half seconds; a note's throw sends it into the reverb whole.

notes.lpHz: 1.7 kHz: the clang's partials past it are gone, so it rings dark.
notes.timbres: none declared: a sketch row, held at nought (AWAITING) until his pick admits it
notes.attack: 0.07 s and the index 0.35 + 0.9 per unit of velocity (was 0.003 s, 0.6 + 2.0): round dark-fronts' fifth pass, his ear on the live app ('bells still too loud'): a slower strike and darker first partials, so the bell reads as a shimmer behind the music, not a strike.
